tool-418b066cb3a401fd.rationale: Returns a redacted evidence capsule from the local AuthzLoom store and does not send target traffic.
tool-418b066cb3a401fd.saferAlternative: Inspect run status first and export only the required redacted capsule.

tool-69c3136c5e53bbf7.rationale: Executes the bounded authorization matrix and may send state-changing requests through the configured transport, then stores redacted evidence.
tool-69c3136c5e53bbf7.saferAlternative: Call authzloom_plan first, review the matrix and policy limits, then approve authzloom_run only when target execution is intended.

tool-cae76fab9f2025d7.rationale: Validates the supplied scenario and returns its authorization matrix without executing requests or changing stored runs.
tool-cae76fab9f2025d7.saferAlternative: Use authzloom_plan to inspect the bounded matrix before any execution request.

tool-d0e02aa57b90cd76.rationale: Lists local run metadata with bounded pagination and does not send target traffic.
tool-d0e02aa57b90cd76.saferAlternative: Use bounded limit and offset values when inspecting local run status.

tool-db3928748425fd7a.rationale: Registers bounded capture metadata in local process memory or redacts a supplied snapshot; raw capture bytes are rejected.
tool-db3928748425fd7a.saferAlternative: Send only an opaque capture handle and the minimum metadata required for planning.
